description: The one Vocab window. Through the folder plugin the page opens the two roots Rust names at startup, by name: Vocab's AppData root, whose connections.md lists the endpoints the learner connected (customEndpoints from @epicenter/ai), and its data folder (openFolder from @epicenter/folder), ~/Epicenter/vocab, which its bundle identifier names and which the first open makes when nothing is there. The page holds no path but the one it shows. No capability names a folder. Through the folder plugin it may ask Epicenter to sync the data folder (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does. It signs in with Epicenter for hosted tutor models and dictation and sends the account's requests with a token it never holds, and keeps its connected endpoints' keys in the keychain, and sends its requests to them through the shell, which adds the key and sends only to the endpoint the key was saved for (connection_fetch).
